controles.affirmation: hook + fondamental_interne #1 : 'Bell a epuise la quasi-totalite des fonds federaux 2026 MV-75 mi-juillet 2026 et continue a ses propres frais ; ajustement defavorable pouvant atteindre 120 M$ et impact tresorerie d'environ 350 M$'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 Commitments and Contingencies, MV-75 Program - Funding : 'Subsequent to the end of our second quarter, in mid-July 2026, Bell exhausted substantially all currently available fiscal 2026 MV-75 program funds and, since then, has continued working on the MV-75 program at its own risk. Therefore, if the ATR is not approved and obligated pursuant to a contract modification, Bell will continue to incur costs in excess of fiscal 2026 program funding for which it may not be reimbursed by the U.S. Government. In such event, we would recognize an unfavorable cumulative catch-up program adjustment of up to approximately $120 million, assuming $350 million in costs incurred in excess of available funding which would also negatively impact our cash flows by approximately $350 million.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #1 : 'un second ajustement defavorable de 60 a 110 M$ est deja anticipe lors de l'attribution de la LRIP, prevue fin 2026 ou debut 2027 ; le programme resterait globalement beneficiaire'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12, Low-Rate Initial Production Option : 'we expect that we will be awarded the long-lead Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) phase of the contract in late 2026 or early 2027. Upon award of the LRIP option, which is largely fixed price, we expect to record an unfavorable cumulative catch-up program adjustment, reflecting higher costs than originally anticipated from when the program was bid, in the range of $60 million to $110 million. We expect the overall MV-75 program to continue to generate a positive profit margin after the adjustment.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 (preuve) : citation fusionnee 'the U.S. Government is pursuing an Above Threshold Reprogramming (ATR) request for $350 million in additional funds for the MV-75 program ... which is subject to Congressional approval and is not guaranteed'
controles.verbatim_source: Les deux fragments existent mais proviennent de DEUX paragraphes distincts de la Note 12, relatifs a deux courriers differents. Courrier du 28 avril 2026 : 'on April 28, 2026, Bell received a letter from the U.S. Army Contracting Command (the Contracting Command) stating that the U.S. Government is pursuing an Above Threshold Reprogramming (ATR) request for $350 million in additional funds for the MV-75 program for the U.S. Government's fiscal year ending September 30, 2026.' Courrier du 8 mai 2026 : 'The letter reiterated that the U.S. Government is pursuing the ATR request for additional funding, which is subject to Congressional approval and is not guaranteed.' Le fond (soumis a l'approbation du Congres, non garanti) est exact.
controles.correction_proposee: Optionnel : signaler que les points de suspension relient deux courriers distincts (28 avril et 8 mai 2026), pour eviter toute lecture d'une phrase unique.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_externe #1 : 'l'Armee a explicitement indique que le gouvernement n'a aucune obligation de rembourser les couts engages par Bell au-dela des fonds actuellement alloues'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 : 'The letter stated that the U.S. Government is not obligated to reimburse Bell for any costs incurred beyond the current obligated funding allotted in the contract and that any performance beyond the allotted funds is at Bell's own risk.'

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #2 : 'separation du segment Industrial annoncee le 30 avril 2026, delai vise 12 a 18 mois, aucune assurance sur le calendrier ni la structure ; Industrial = 21,8% du CA 2025'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 8 : 'On April 30, 2026, Textron announced its intent to separate its Industrial segment from the Company... including but not limited to a sale of the Industrial businesses or a tax-free separation into a standalone, publicly traded company. The Company is targeting completion of the separation within 12 to 18 months from the original announcement, subject to... receipt of any required regulatory approvals and final approval of the Company's Board of Directors. There can be no assurance regarding the ultimate timing or structure of the proposed separation or that a transaction will be completed.' 10-K FY2025 : Industrial 3 213 M$ sur 14 799 M$ de CA total = 21,71% (21,82% rapporte aux seuls revenus Manufacturing, 14 724 M$). Les 21,8% sont donc defendables.

controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #3 : 'part courante de la dette LT de 5 M$ au 3 janvier 2026 a 355 M$ au 4 juillet 2026 ; tresorerie consolidee -419 M$ a 1 606 M$ ; 377 M$ de rachats d'actions ; capex +70% (228 M$ contre 134 M$)'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Consolidated Balance Sheets : 'Current portion of long-term debt | $ 355 | $ 5'. Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows : 'Net decrease in cash and equivalents | ( 419 )', 'Cash and equivalents at end of period | $ 1,606', 'Purchases of Textron common stock | ( 377 )', 'Capital expenditures | ( 228 ) | ( 134 )'. Capex : +70,1%.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #1 : 'Marge segmentaire Bell 6,98% au T2 2026 (75 M$ / 1 074 M$) contre 7,87% au T2 2025 (80 / 1 016) ; 6,86% au S1 2026 (147 / 2 144) contre 8,50% (170 / 1 999)'
quantitatif #1 (perspective) : 'le chiffre d'affaires de Bell progresse de 5,7% au premier semestre'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 8 : Bell S1 2026 2 144 M$ contre S1 2025 1 999 M$, soit +7,25%. Le +5,7% est la progression du DEUXIEME TRIMESTRE seul (1 074 / 1 016 = +5,71%). Erreur de periode.
controles.correction_proposee: 'le chiffre d'affaires de Bell progresse de 7,3% au premier semestre' (ou 'de 5,7% au deuxieme trimestre' si l'on veut conserver le chiffre).

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #1 (perspective) : 'la direction attribue explicitement le recul de 100 points de base de la marge brute consolidee a la marge plus faible du segment Bell'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 2, Cost of Sales : 'Gross margin as a percentage of Manufacturing revenues decreased 100 basis points in the first half of 2026, primarily due to lower margin at the Bell segment.'

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #2 : 'Marge brute Manufacturing 17,8% au S1 2026 contre 18,8% un an plus tot ; hausse de 7% du CA total'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Consolidated Results of Operations : 'Gross margin as a % of Manufacturing revenues | 17.8% | 18.8% | 17.8% | 18.8%' ; revenus S1 '7,522 / 7,022 / 7%'.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #2 (perspective) : 'La baisse provient d'un impact inflation de 148 M$ et d'une provision LIFO plus elevee sur le semestre'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 2 : 'Cost of sales increased $477 million, 8%, in the first half of 2026... largely due to higher net volume and mix of $332 million and a $148 million impact from inflation and higher LIFO inventory provision.' Les 148 M$ couvrent CONJOINTEMENT l'inflation ET la hausse de la provision LIFO ; le document ne chiffre pas separement l'inflation. L'ATT presente 148 M$ comme le seul effet inflation, auquel s'ajouterait une provision LIFO, ce qui gonfle l'impact total.
controles.correction_proposee: 'La baisse provient d'un impact combine de 148 M$ lie a l'inflation et a une provision LIFO plus elevee sur le semestre'.

controles.affirmation: quantitatif #3 : 'Backlog Bell 7 538 M$ au 4 juillet 2026 contre 7 795 M$ au 3 janvier 2026 (-3,3%) ; total groupe +0,5% (18 914 contre 18 823), Aviation +3,9%, Systems +1,3%'
resume : 'le benefice par action progresse de 5% au premier semestre 2026'
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Consolidated Statements of Operations, BPA dilue : 'Diluted | $ 1.42 | $ 1.35 | $ 2.67 | $ 2.48'. Le BPA dilue du S1 2026 progresse de +7,7% (2,67 contre 2,48). Le +5% est le chiffre du DEUXIEME TRIMESTRE (1,42 contre 1,35 = +5,2%). Erreur de periode, identique a celle du CA Bell.
controles.correction_proposee: 'le chiffre d'affaires progresse de 7% au premier semestre 2026 et le benefice par action dilue de 8%'.
